## Checklist

- [ ] If this touches shared logic (`MIDAS_Main.m`, a `plot_*.m` function, `export_pub_fig.m`, etc.), it's applied to **all three** of `matlab/`, `GUI/`, and `octave/`, unless it's genuinely MATLAB- or Octave-specific.
- [ ] Ran the smoke check locally (`cd matlab` (or `GUI`, or `octave`); `addpath('../.github/scripts')`; `smoke_test`).
- [ ] Comments explain **why**, not what the code already makes obvious (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`, if user-facing.
